title: 第28章 画中人

第28章 画中人-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

王大雷见吴姜回来，手里还揣着一卷用锦缎裹着的古画，顿时来了兴致，刚想接过看看，就被吴姜三言两语的糊弄过去了。

王大雷出去买了午饭回来，两人就着冰啤酒饱餐了一顿。

夏天的午后，就是容易犯困，吴姜打着哈欠，进了里面一个小房间睡觉去了。

少东家，就是这么任性！

等吴姜揉着眼出来的时候，王大雷正坐在椅子上，脑袋上下一点一点的，很明显，这位主也是犯困了。

“王哥，你去里面睡会儿吧，我来看店。”吴姜叫醒王大雷，王大雷也不跟他客气，径直去了里面睡觉去了。

店里只剩下了吴姜一个人，他这才拿起画卷看了起来，只是刚刚打开，就有一对年轻情侣进店了。

吴姜只好收起画轴，上前接待。

还不错，卖了一块灵璧石，进账几百块。

这时他也不研究古画了，给自己泡了杯茶，找了本小说，打发时间。

等到王大雷出来，吴姜就坐不住了，准备溜号了。

“王哥，我先回家了，别给我妈打电话啊！”吴姜抓起桌上的古画，对着王大雷喊了一声。

王大雷正低头擦着一个砚台，头也不抬地说道：“行，去吧，别偷偷去干坏事啊！”

吴姜笑着骂了一声，这才抱着古画走出了墨香居。

吴姜去逛4S店了，只是一个人看车实在无聊，试了试驾，也没决定要买什么品牌，最后在销售员小姐姐留恋的目光中，无情的走了。

吴姜到家时，老妈王雅琴还没回来，应该是又和老姐妹们凑在一起打麻将了。

他先把古画放回自己卧室，转身钻进卫生间洗澡。

等他擦着湿漉漉的头发出来时，王雅琴正好开门进来。

“咦？你这小子怎么回来这么早？”王雅琴抬眼看见儿子，顿时柳眉一竖，语气里带着几分质问。

吴姜立刻换上一副嬉皮笑脸的模样，快步上前抱住老妈的胳膊，：“老妈，我哪有翘班呀，古玩城都快没人了，我才提前回来的。老妈，我想吃你做的酸菜鱼了，晚上我们吃鱼好不好？”

王雅琴对儿子这么大了，还对她撒娇很受用，也就不再计较吴姜翘班的事情了。

Chapter 28 The person in the painting - "The city god is my ancestor, it turns out that I am the Nth generation of gods"

When Wang Dalei saw Wu Jiang coming back with a scroll of ancient paintings wrapped in brocade in his hand, he suddenly became interested. Just as he was about to take it and take a look, Wu Jiang fooled him into passing it with a few words.

Wang Dalei went out to buy lunch and came back, and the two of them had a hearty meal with cold beer.

In the summer afternoon, it was easy to feel sleepy. Wu Jiang yawned and went to sleep in a small room inside.

The young master is so willful!

When Wu Jiang came out rubbing his eyes, Wang Dalei was sitting on the chair, his head moving up and down. It was obvious that the master was also sleepy.

"Brother Wang, go inside and sleep for a while. I'll look at the store." Wu Jiang woke up Wang Dalei, but Wang Dalei didn't show politeness to him and went straight inside to sleep.

Wu Jiang was the only one left in the store. He picked up the scroll and started reading it. But as soon as he opened it, a young couple entered the store.

Wu Jiang had no choice but to put away the scroll and step forward to receive him.

Not bad, I sold a piece of Lingbi stone and made a few hundred yuan.

At this time, he stopped studying ancient paintings, made himself a cup of tea, and found a novel to pass the time.

When Wang Dalei came out, Wu Jiang couldn't sit still and was ready to leave.

"Brother Wang, I'm going home first, don't call my mother!" Wu Jiang grabbed the ancient painting on the table and shouted to Wang Dalei.

Wang Dalei was wiping an inkstone with his head down, and said without raising his head: "Okay, go ahead, don't do bad things secretly!"

Wu Jiang smiled and cursed before walking out of Moxiangju holding the ancient painting.

Wu Jiang went to the 4S store, but it was boring to look at cars alone. He tried a test drive, but didn't decide which brand to buy. In the end, he left heartlessly under the nostalgic eyes of the salesperson.

When Wu Jiang got home, his mother, Wang Yaqin, had not come back yet. She must have been playing mahjong with her old sisters again.

He first put the ancient paintings back in his bedroom, then turned around and got into the bathroom to take a shower.

When he came out wiping his wet hair, Wang Yaqin happened to open the door and come in.

"Eh? Why are you back so early?" Wang Yaqin raised her eyebrows and raised her eyebrows when she saw her son, with a hint of questioning in her tone.

Wu Jiang immediately put on a playful and smiling face, quickly stepped forward and hugged his mother's arm, saying, "Mom, how could I miss work? The antique city is almost empty, so I came back early. Mom, I want to eat the pickled fish you made. Can we eat fish tonight?"

Wang Yaqin was so used to her son being so coquettish that she no longer cared about Wu Jiang skipping work.
